item.tib: rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi skyes rabs rnams (rnam) bshad nor bu'i phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar bdag cag ston pa dgra bcom rgyal ba gshen rab de nyid grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags sgrib sbrang gis mthar thugs mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas nas/ bcu gnyis mdzad chen yongs dang rgyal bstan 'byung tshul gyi legs par bshad pa'i brgyan pa rtogs brjod rin po che 'di nyid spros thub kyi thos bsam cher med na'ang/ 'khrungs rab zhal skyin tsam las don bshad rgyas bsdus snga phyi mkhas grub rnams kyis bsgrig rgyur ma byung ba/ de phyir chos brgyad mkhas grags kyis bsgrigs pa min cing/ rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan dang / de 'dra'i mkhas grub tshe rigs kyi mkhyen ngor gsal ba bzhin slar gsal gdab pa dang / rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams yid la nges shes bskyed pa'i ched du/ dang po thugs bskyed tshul dang grangs med nges don du byas pa'i skor rnams kun grol rin po che yi skor phyag 'grel dang mdzad bcu'i rnam bshad gtso bor bzhag nas bkod/ grangs can gyi skyes rabs rnam thar mdo rgyud kun nas 'khrungs rabs mthong thos rnams bsdus nas rnam bshad nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bgyi ba glegs bam gcig tu dril ba 'di/ gnam bskos gong ma'i bsngags pa'i sa dbang sde dge rgyal po'i mnga' ris bu 'bor dbyibs klung du dal rten rnyed pa/ sngon bsags dkar po'i 'phro yis smon rgyal pad ma rgyal po'i yang srid du khab che ba/ ming tsam ma yin pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i g.yung drung slob dpon du ma'i zhabs bsnoms pa'i sum ldan gyi khul 'dzin pa'i gyi na ba g.yung drung bstan pa dbang rgyal du 'bod pa ston mchog khri gtsug rgyal ba'i sku dang gsung bstan nyis khri rdzogs shing / thugs bstan khri la nyis stong bdun brgya re bzhi 'das pa'i mtshams/ legs sbyar sam skri ta'i skad du sarba d+ha ri/ stod 'grel las bod skad du bsgyar bkun 'dzin ting kun rgyal po'i khabs su wu tsa'i/ dbang thang dang mthun pa'i ming sa pho byi ba'i lor/ tha skar zla ba'i tshes rdzogs pa dang po res bza' lha mtshams la spyod pa'i 'grub sbyor nyin du dbu btsugs nas mgo zla ba'i grub pa'i nyi mar mjug phyung ba yan/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal kun grol grags kyi gdan sa dga' ldan dar rgyas nor bu'i gling du bskrun pas/ mnyam med rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs mthong thos kyi lus can rnams byang chub lam bzang bgrod pa'i bskul mar gyur pa dang / phan bde'i rtsa lag gshen bstan rin po che phyogs brgyar kun tu dar zhing yun ring du gnas nas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
